stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Why was the cuckoo billed twice?

stations.title: Kasimir's bench
stations.text: Finished repairs leave for the desk.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: Nobody knows who has a repair

stations.title: Ambrose's desk
stations.text: Each repair billed once, then let go.

captions: Ambrose bills finished repairs, and the cuckoo clock got two bills last week.
It sat on Kasimir's bench and on his desk at once, and both lists billed it.
You give every repair one owner that moves from the bench to the desk.
Now the cuckoo clock is on the desk alone, billed once, and ends when it goes.
Each repair is in exactly one place. Next, repairs that two lists must share.
